dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Has something happened?

dialogues.speaker: Ovsyannikov
dialogues.text: We're talking about how every single tavern in Snezhnograd is diluting proper fire-water with fruit juice these days!

dialogues.speaker: Ovsyannikov
dialogues.text: How ridiculous is that? There used to be a proper way to drink fire-water: you gulp it down in one go, then you chase it with a slice of pickle and a piece of black bread. That's the right way to do it.

dialogues.speaker: Ovsyannikov
dialogues.text: That's exactly how my elders did it when they were out on the Belyi Tsar's campaigns!

dialogues.speaker: Ovsyannikov
dialogues.text: And look at what we're stuck with now. We've completely lost the old ways, I'm telling you. Everything is just frills and gimmicks these days.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Please excuse the interruption.

dialogues.speaker: Ovsyannikov
dialogues.text: May the Belyi Tsar preserve us!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Surely it isn't that big a deal...

dialogues.speaker: Ovsyannikov
dialogues.text: *Sigh* It's because of people like you who mindlessly follow every new trend that we're losing the old ways! The actual ways of our ancestors!

dialogues.speaker: Ovsyannikov
dialogues.text: Fae nowadays have zero sense of propriety! Mark my words, at this rate, we're going to lose the ways of the Pale Star completely!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So you have seen the Belyi Tsar before, then?

dialogues.speaker: Ovsyannikov
dialogues.text: Of cour—— While I've never laid eyes on him myself, but my elders all had ties to the nobility in one way or another. They all served under the banner of the Tsar at some point in their lives!

dialogues.speaker: Ovsyannikov
dialogues.text: Why, do you not believe me? Just look at these markings on my own person! Do you honestly think that's something every stray dog out there walks around with?

dialogues.speaker: Shchukina
dialogues.text: #Please stay a moment, {M#sir}{F#ma'am}— you look as though you've run into trouble...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What do you mean by that?

dialogues.speaker: Shchukina
dialogues.text: For example, have you forgotten to take something with you when you leave the house? Then missed your train after you went back for it? Or maybe you lost your job after fouling up a deal or something. It all sounds pretty ordinary, doesn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Shchukina
dialogues.text: Has anything unlucky happened to you recently?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I don't have time for this.

dialogues.speaker: Shchukina
dialogues.text: #Oy, {M#sir}{F#ma'am} I'm telling you, an opportunity like this doesn't come by every day.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've been having quite a streak, come to think of it.

dialogues.speaker: Shchukina
dialogues.text: Step right up, my friend, because this is what they call a fated encounter! You are incredibly lucky to cross my path today. I can banish all your troubles in a flash, and all I ask in return is a very modest token of compensation.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not really.

dialogues.speaker: Shchukina
dialogues.text: Step right up, my friend, because this is what they call a fated encounter! You are incredibly lucky to cross my path today, before disaster befalls you. I can help with you that, and all I ask in return is a very modest token of compensation.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You want money for that? Forget it, then.

dialogues.speaker: Shchukina
dialogues.text: #Don't go just yet, {M#sir}{F#ma'am}! Encounters of fate like this don't happen every day! I can give you a discount if you like...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You want money for that? Forget it, then.
